So we can accept? But we might try to improve. The dataset card says weighted w1 best on dataset. But maybe we can try robust combination: median or trimmed mean on stable pool. But baseline weighted w1 is best. But we can try prune redundant and then weighted inverse error? But risk high variance. Maybe try prune_redundant then weighted inverse error? But we have only 3 windows, high variance. Weighted inverse error might overfit. Maybe try weights_best_per_horizon? But we have 12 horizons, but only 3 windows. Might be unstable.

Given leader is indistinguishable, we can accept. But we might try to test a robust median on stable pool. But we already have median baseline 0.7474, worse. Weighted w1 is best. So accept.
